description: Find x402 services imported from attributed catalogs or scanned by Mekler. Filter by task text, host, category, network, source, tier, grade or owner control. Only identity-reviewed listings with a grade and a current known health reading are displayed. Ineligible listings are retained privately until evidence qualifies them; unknown prices stay unknown. Payment-ready means a recent valid unsigned challenge; it does not certify useful paid delivery. Numbered page requests read the current eligible results and count from one snapshot; out-of-range pages clamp to the last page. A page cannot be combined with a cursor. Immutable cursors retain ordering while current privacy controls still apply. Never signs payments.

page.description: One-based page over current eligible results. Clamped to the last page; cannot be combined with cursor.

name: search_listings
